kill_criteria: trailing 90-day value under $10k a year at the quoted size
any confirmation paying less than its WithdrawalQueued hypeAmount, or a non-zero unstakeFeeRate
the fastest confirmation over a month above 10 days
withdrawals paused for over a week
legs: buy kHYPE with WHYPE on the kHYPE/WHYPE pools (Ramses v3, Nest, Project X, Hybra) behind a seller when the median venue's discount less one fee clears the hurdle
confirmWithdrawal after 7 days; unwrap or reuse the HYPE
mechanism: Anyone can queueWithdrawal(kHYPE) on Kinetiq's StakingManager (0x393d...2109); the HYPE amount is fixed at the request at StakingAccountant.kHYPEToHYPE and confirmWithdrawal pays it after withdrawalDelay (604,800 s). Every one of 13,426 confirmations since launch paid exactly its request; the 10bp unstake fee was set to zero on 2026-04-08T00:14:01Z. The bid prices against kHYPEToHYPE, waits the fastest confirmation seen within a day of each fill (never under 7 days), charges two pool fees and the staking yield forgone while queued, and caps each fill at the median venue less one fee.
name: Buy kHYPE below the HYPE Kinetiq pays for it and redeem through the 7-day queue

quotes.note: hurdle h=20 chosen on the first half, scored on the second

risks: HYPE price exposure of the capital unless hedged (a short HYPE perp, which itself earns funding)
Kinetiq contract, validator slashing and governance risk on HYPE queued for a week
other bidders (Valantis STEX, arbitrageurs) not simulated: values are ceilings for one participant
thesis: kHYPE trades below the HYPE its withdrawal queue pays: 9.8bp at the hourly median and 30.1bp at the 90th percentile over 452 days of swaps rebuilt from chain. A $10,000,000 bid that redeems every fill made $140,043 a year out of sample (95% interval $17,327 to $356,703), $245,331 over the trailing 90 days.

change: replace the HYPE spot leg (HyperCore portfolio margin) with kHYPE on HyperLend; same short, same size
kill_criteria: the HYPE carry's own kill criteria (hl-hype-spot-perp-carry)
HyperLend USDT0 borrow above 15% for a week, or kHYPE LTV cut below 0.4
kHYPE oracle on HyperLend switched to a market feed
Kinetiq withdrawals paused or a non-zero unstake fee
legs: buy HYPE and mint kHYPE (or buy kHYPE below the rate on HyperEVM)
supply kHYPE to HyperLend; borrow USDT0 (10% of notional)
short the HYPE perp on Hyperliquid for the same notional
mechanism: Hyperliquid portfolio margin accepts only USDC, USDT, HYPE and BTC, so kHYPE cannot collateralise the short on HyperCore: kHYPE is supplied to HyperLend (LTV 59%%, liquidation 74%%, priced at the Kinetiq exchange rate by a fundamental oracle), USDT0 is borrowed for 10%% of notional and moved to HyperCore as the short's margin; losses after a rise are borrowed too and the legs are rebalanced after a 25%% move. The kHYPE leg is marked at the market discount daily; it exits through the queue at the rate.
name: HYPE spot/short-perp carry, upgraded: kHYPE as the spot leg, the short's margin borrowed on HyperLend

thesis: The Hyperliquid HYPE carry, with the spot leg held as kHYPE: staking +2.05% a year on top of funding. Over the same window the kHYPE version beat the spot version by +1.21% a year out of sample (+4.48% vs +3.27% over SSR, t 2.93), after paying HyperLend's USDT0 rate (+10.40%) on the short's margin instead of Hyperliquid's portfolio-margin rate.
